row.evidence: Lightspeed's X-Series help says its OpenID Connect SSO ("Available on Plus") creates users from the IdP's identity token; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre or the X-Series API reference.
row.notes: Vend is now Lightspeed Retail POS (X-Series); vendhq.com redirects to lightspeedhq.com/vend. No SCIM. Plus-plan OIDC SSO creates users from ID-token claims at sign-in (JIT) and, in 'Access management' mode, maps role and outlet from the IdP; the Account Owner keeps Retail POS credentials. Pricing is flat per location, not per user: Basic $89, Core $149, Plus $289 per month on the default (annual) billing toggle; prices shown are per location with Lightspeed Payments in the embedded price data. The X-Series REST API (OAuth scopes users:read / users:write) lists, gets and deletes users, deletes a user's sessions and lists audit events; no user create/update endpoint is listed. API access per current tier is not legible on the pricing page (icon table); a legacy help article lists API Access as a Pro-plan feature. No Okta OIN or Entra gallery app was found.
